payload.context: A gate that PRINTS its blocking marker and exits 0. S287 built a behavioural census keyed on a vocabulary of BLINDNESS (UNMEASURED/DARK-PRODUCER); that misses the gate which sees perfectly, stamps the finding blocking, and returns success. Obelisk had 1 live in-chain case and 7 out-of-chain.
payload.solution: Add a third census arm keyed on the gate OWN blocking marker with exitCode 0. Silence it only with a dated claim the gate restates in its own render (Nd of cover left / waived until YYYY-MM-DD) that the census RE-VERIFIES, so an expired cover silences nothing. Second: the census denominator must range over every script that can print a verdict, not only the enforcing chain — behavioural where you can safely run it, static (no non-zero exit path exists at all) where you cannot, and a declared-advisory marker as the only silencer.
